params.name: project
params.description: The normalized name of the Python package on PyPI.

items.docs: Returns metadata about an individual project at the latest version, including a list of all releases for that project, project URLs, and known vulnerabilities. The response includes info, last_serial, releases, urls, and vulnerabilities fields.
